title: BUILD-035-b2b-partner-opportunity-board
universal_lens: The B2B partner board formalizes a constrained optimization over an open-source leverage manifold. We define a state-transition operator mapping unstructured OSS capabilities into bounded, reviewable GSE workflows, subject to strict topological isolation constraints that prevent production leakage and enforce rigorous legal boundary conditions.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, this maps to a Bayesian filtering process where the prior is established by isolated OSS documentation analysis. Conformal prediction intervals bound the expected reduction in SaaS costs, while the approval gates act as sequential hypothesis tests preventing high-variance, unverified integrations from entering the production inference pipeline.
gse_mapping: GSE situational reasoning treats the build card as a discrete Markov transition from a sandboxed research state to an operational CRM state. The state vector evolves strictly within the `docs/research` subspace until explicit founder authorization triggers a controlled projection into the live application API layer.

primitives.name: Open-Source Leverage Projection Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters This improves decision quality, revenue, speed, support, retention, trust, or cost savings by converting open-source leverage into a bounded GSE workflow.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L: Open-source capability space (dimensionless), W: Bounded GSE workflow space (dimensionless), ΔV: Value increment (USD/time)
primitives.assumptions: The mapping from L to W is non-surjective and requires explicit boundary definitions to preserve system integrity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the workflow bounds are violated, leading to uncontrolled production coupling or license contamination.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to projecting high-dimensional external feature spaces into a low-dimensional, secure internal latent space for safe consumption.
layer2.telemetry: Reduction in manual coordination hours and verified SaaS cost avoidance.

primitives.name: Topological Sandbox Isolation Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Security Boundary No secrets, production data, customer PII, proprietary method docs, payment data, or production source keys.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S_prod: Production secret set, S_sandbox: Sandbox state set, ∩: Intersection operator
primitives.assumptions: The intersection of the sandbox state space and the production secret space must remain exactly empty during the research phase.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if PII or cryptographic keys leak into the sandbox, triggering immediate security failure and rollback.

layer2.mapping: Derives a zero-knowledge kernel ensuring that external OSS evaluation cannot query or mutate sensitive internal production tensors.
layer2.telemetry: Zero incidents of credential exposure; successful execution of isolated unit tests.

primitives.name: Sequential Approval Gate Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: Start in docs or a sandbox and only move into app code after explicit approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: θ: Heaviside step function for approval, t: Time, D: Documentation state, A: Application state
primitives.assumptions: State transitions are strictly causal and require a binary authorization event to cross the documentation-to-code boundary.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if implicit merges bypass the gate, resulting in unauthorized production deployments of unvetted OSS wrappers.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to a gated Markov Decision Process where the reward function is only evaluated post-authorization.
layer2.telemetry: Number of approved PRs transitioning from docs/ to apps/ directories.
